Figure 1:Subject-wise data splits. (a) Schematic illustration of the dataset. A single extensively recorded subject is shown alongside other subjects with progressively reduced amounts of available training data. (b) Quantitative representation of the data splits.
A broken y-axis is used to accommodate the large difference between sub-0 and the other subjects, while preserving the visibility of differences in training data proportions. Vertical dashed lines separate the subject groups, and labels indicate the proportion of training data available within each group. A decreasing curve illustrates the overall reduction in available training data across subjects.
